answer: ZK proof-of-post-epoch generation: at the mesa, each identity must submit a zk-SNARK of a 500 CPU-hour rendering unique to its epoch seed. A prism splits honest from cloned proofs; ivory-grade verifiers reject recycled witnesses. Faking 1,000 identities costs 500k CPU-hours plus $12 each, so $12k burns before one epoch's modest payout. Economics fail long before scale.
